preconditions.expression: all(0 < x <= 10^9 for x in input_numbers)
preconditions.description: All input numbers are positive integers and each is not greater than 10^9.
There are exactly four input numbers.

postconditions.description: The output is '-1' if the safe cannot be cracked, otherwise it is a string of operations not exceeding 1000 lines.

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' ==> all(x == 1 for x in input_numbers) or any(output.count(f'/{i}') == 0 and output.count(f'+{i}') == 0 for i in range(1, 5))
postconditions.description: If the safe is cracked, all numbers must be 1 after the operations, or there must be at least one operation that divides two adjacent numbers by 2.
